newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Some frozen Russian Minfins bonds released.
newsitem.headline: Some frozen Russian Minfins bonds released.

text.p: Russian officials have released some frozen MinFin bonds following an order from Prosecutor-General Yuri Skuratov to review all cases of freezing, Itar-Tass news agency said on Wednesday.
Several orders to release frozen bonds had been issued within a day of Skuratov's order, it said quoting Skuratov's aide Alexander Zvyagintsev.
Tass did not say how many MinFins had been released in all so far.
But it said in one case the Tagansk district prosecutor in Moscow had released MinFins totalling $21 million face value.
Earlier Tass said Skuratov had ordered the authorities to review all cases of frozen MinFin bonds within a month and if necessary release those acquired in good faith.
